title: Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency
author: Douglas Adams
summary: A murder in Cambridge, a missing cat and a ghost lead the odd detective Dirk Gently to follow the fundamental interconnectedness of all things. Douglas Adams ties it together with time travel and an electric monk.
readIf: you like absurd, witty mysteries where the logic is deliberately bizarre.
skipIf: you want a conventional detective story with fair-play clues.
